stem: In each section of this question an organic compound is shown. For each compound give its name and answer the questions about it.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State and explain how many stereoisomers of this structure there are.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the **skeletal** formula of the organic product of the reaction of this compound with cold, dilute, acidified manganate(VII) ions.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Name the organic product of the reaction of this compound with hot, concentrated, acidified manganate(VII) ions.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Draw the structure of part of a molecule of the addition polymer formed from this compound, showing exactly **three** repeat units.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Complete the mechanism for the reaction of this compound with hydrogen bromide. Include all necessary curly arrows, lone pairs, charges and partial charges.

{{figure:visual_auto_03.png}}

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain fully why 2-bromomethylpropane is the major product of this reaction while only relatively small amounts of 1-bromomethylpropane are produced.
